4D Reading
Three jobs, three days
Read about Tom, Aiko and Leo. Then answer the questions.
4D Present simple: yes/no questions
He works. Does he work?
Compare the sentences. What changes in the question?
Statement
Tom gets up at five.
Aiko works at night.
he / she / it + verb + s
Question
Does Tom get up at five? Yes, he does.
Does Aiko work in the morning? No, she doesn't.
Does + he / she / it + verb ?
LOOKThe -s moves from the verb to does: works → does … workGrammar Bank, p. 107
4D How it works
Questions with Does
Does
she
work?

For he, she, it we start the question with Does. The verb has no -s.

1
Does + he / she / it + verb
Does + she + work + …?
Does she work at night?Does it start at nine?
2
Short answers
Yes, he does.No, she doesn't.
3
No -s after does
✗ Does he lives here?✓ Does he live here?✗ No, it doesn't starts.✓ No, it doesn't.
4
Do or Does?
I / you / we / they → Do he / she / it → Does
Do you like tea?Does your sister like tea?
5
Is or Does?
Is + noun / adjective Does + verb
Is he a baker?Does he make bread?

Homework

Write 6 questions with Does about a person you know: your mum, a friend or a colleague. Then write the answers.

  • Does my sister get up early? Yes, she does.
  • Use 3 different verbs: work, like, drink, cook, watch…
  • Write 2 answers with No, he / she doesn't.
  • Bonus: order your favourite breakfast in English.

Worksheet: PDF for the teacher, page 4.
